method: Authenticated Vercel deployment history, paginated across the selected 24-hour interval and grouped by project, state and Git metadata.

pilotFailure.message: Resource is limited - try again in 24 hours (more than 100)

interpretation: The history is dominated by Treido project deployments, not the ten Varna framework-build jobs. 137 is the number of deployment records, not successful deployments. READY, ERROR and CANCELED records are retained separately; this audit does not claim to reconstruct Vercel's exact internal quota accounting or reset timestamp.
